The '''''Lumrunner''''' was the personal [[PB-950 patrol boat]] of the space [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Shamus Falconi]]. He inherited the ship from his grandmother. The ''Lumrunner'' was over 300 years old when his grandmother captured it at the beginning of her pirate career.<ref name="AJ9" />
